foundation: First-Order Tarski-Grothendieck Set Theory (ZFC + Grothendieck Universes)

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Mathematical induction & case elimination: nnind, uzind, jaoi $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit induction theorems (`nnind` on `N`, `uzind` on `Z>=M`, `sfind` on finite sets) paired with explicit substitution lemmas (`fveq`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Construct explicit substitution lemmas for `P(0)`, `P(k)`, `P(k+1)`, and `P(n)` before applying `nnind` or `uzind`.
dialect_pitfalls: All 4 substitution hypotheses must be proven explicitly before invoking `nnind` or `uzind`
Forgetting disjoint-variable `$d` constraints on the induction variable
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: induction n with | zero => h0 | succ n' ih => hsucc

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Truth value & decimal computation theorems: tru, decadd, decmul $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Propositional truth constant `T.` (`df-tru`) and explicit decimal arithmetic / Pratt certificate theorems (`decadd`, `decmul`, `prmo`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Collapse multi-step decimal evaluation (`decadd`, `decmul`) or finite truth-table checks into `decide` or `norm_num` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Metamath has no kernel reduction; every computational step is an explicit theorem application
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by decide

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Congruence & transitivity rewriting: eqtri, 3eqtr4i, fveq2i $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit equality transitivity (`eqtri`, `3eqtr4i`) and explicit functorial congruence lemmas (`fveq1i`, `fveq2i`, `oveq12i`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace Metamath congruence chains (`fveq2i`, `oveq12i`, `3eqtr4i`) with `rw [...]` or `simp only [...]` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Every subterm position requires its own congruence theorem (`oveq1i` vs `oveq2i`) in Metamath
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: simp only [add_comm, mul_zero]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: G e. Grp , B = ( Base ` G ) , .+ = ( +g ` G )
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Extensible structure tuples encoded as functions on numeric slot indices (`Base`, `+g`, `.r`, `0g`) with class membership `G e. Grp`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Convert `G e. Grp` and slot projections `(Base ` G)`, `(+g ` G)` into `(G : Type*) [Group G]` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Metamath structure operations are untyped total class functions outside `(Base ` G)`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: class Group (G : Type u) extends Monoid G, Inv G where ...

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Hilbert propositional & first-order chains: ax-1..3, mp, syl, mpd $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit Hilbert-style deduction chains synthesized by `mmj2` unification search.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Collapse 10-100 step Hilbert propositional/syllogism subproofs in `set.mm` into `tauto`, `aesop`, `omega`, or `ring` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Never port raw `syl`/`mpd`/`com12` plumbing lemmas 1-to-1 into Lean 4
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: aesop (add safe ...) or omega

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Transitive calculation chain: 3eqtri, eqletr, lelttr $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: N-ary transitive chain theorems (`3eqtri`, `3eqtr4i`, `eqletr`, `lelttr`, `ltletr`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Unpack nested `3eqtri` / `eqletr` / `lelttr` applications into a linear `calc` block in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Keep track of strict (`<`, `ltletr`) vs weak (`<=`, `letr`) steps when flattening tree-structured transitivity proofs
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: calc a = b := h1 _ <= c := h2 _ < d := h3

mechanisms.dialect_semantics: ZFC equivalence-class quotient `A /. R = { [x]_R | x e. A }` where `R` is an equivalence relation (`R EqvRel A`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `(A /. R)` to `Quotient s` and `[x]_R = [y]_R <-> x R y` (`qseleq`) to `Quotient.eq`.
dialect_pitfalls: Metamath `[x]_R` is a set of elements `⊆ A`, whereas Lean `Quotient s` is an abstract type
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Quot.sound (h : a ~ b) or Quotient.lift f h_resp

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Constructor injectivity & disjointness: peano2, peano5, opth $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Explicit Peano/Kuratowski injectivity theorems (`peano5`: `suc m = suc n -> m = n`, `opth` for ordered pairs) and explosion (`pm2.21i`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `peano5`/`opth` to `cases h` or `injection h` and `peano2` (`suc n != 0`) to `nomatch h` / `contradiction`.
dialect_pitfalls: Set-theoretic encodings of constructors in `set.mm` can have accidental junk equalities outside the intended domain
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: injection h with h1 h2 or contradiction

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: P e. Poset , L e. Lat , L e. CLat
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Extensible lattice structures (`Lat`, `CLat`) with join/meet slots and order closures.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `L e. CLat` to `[CompleteLattice α]` and adjoined monotone maps to `GaloisConnection l u`.
dialect_pitfalls: Metamath `sup`/`inf` slots require explicit closure and non-emptiness proofs unless `L e. CLat` is established
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: GaloisConnection l u meaning l a <= b <-> a <= u b

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: { x e. A | ph } , elrab
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Restricted class abstraction `{ x e. A | ph }` (`df-rab`) carving out a subset of `A`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `x e. { y e. A | ph(y) }` (`elrab`) into either a subtype `{x : A // P x}` or a `Set A` membership `x ∈ {y | P y}` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Choose `Set α` (predicates) rather than `Subtype` (`{x : α // P x}`) when frequent subset unions/intersections occur
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: { x : A // P x } or <val, prop>

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Axiom of Choice & definite description: ax-ac, iotacl, pm2.61i $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: ZFC Axiom of Choice (`ax-ac`), Russell's definite description binder `( iota x ph )` (`df-iota`), and classical LEM (`pm2.61i`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `( iota x ph )` (under uniqueness `E! x ph`) or `ax-ac` selection to `Classical.choose` + `Classical.choose_spec` in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: Metamath `( iota x ph )` returns the empty set `(/\)` when uniqueness `E! x ph` fails, whereas `Classical.choose` picks an arbitrary element from any non-empty `∃ x, P x`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Classical.choose (h : exists x, P x) and Classical.choose_spec h

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Discrete trajectory & energy bounds: rtrcl, uzind, sqge0 $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Reflexive-transitive closure (`rtrcl`) and integer-indexed recurrence inequalities via `uzind` and `sqge0`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `uzind` recurrence energy bounds into inductive Lyapunov certificates discharged by `omega`, `linarith`, or `nlinarith`.
dialect_pitfalls: When scaling real Lyapunov energies to `Nat` in Lean 4 (`x 100`), guard all subtraction steps `(V s' <= V s)` against `Nat.sub` truncation
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: theorem invariant_step (s : State) (h_inv : Inv s) : Inv (step s) and V (step s) <= alpha * V s

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Ordered field & ring axioms: leadd1i, sqge0, addass, distr $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: First-principles ring and ordered-field theorems in `set.mm`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace 20-line `set.mm` algebraic/inequality subproofs with a single `ring`, `linarith`, `omega`, or `positivity` call.
dialect_pitfalls: `set.mm` `N` is a subset of `C` so `a - b` is never truncated; guard `Nat.sub` when porting to Lean 4 `Nat`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by omega | by linarith [h1, h2] | by ring | by positivity

mechanisms.canonical_name: Numeric Coercions, Cast Normalization & Denominator Clearing
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Subset tower N c_ Z c_ Q c_ R c_ C: nnz, zcn, adddiv, divcan2 $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Untyped ZFC subset inclusions (`N c_ Z c_ R c_ C`) where all numeric operations are complex operations `+`, `-`, `x.`, `/`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Introduce explicit types `(n : Nat)`, `(z : Int)`, `(x : Real)` when porting `set.mm`, using `push_cast`/`norm_cast` at type boundaries and `field_simp` for `adddiv`/`divcan2`.
dialect_pitfalls: CRITICAL: `set.mm` `m - n` on `m, n e. N` produces a negative integer in `Z` when `m < n`, whereas Lean `(m - n : Nat)` truncates to `0`! Always cast `(m : Int) - (n : Int)` or add `n <= m`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: push_cast; ring | zify [h_le] at *; omega | field_simp [hne]; ring

mechanisms.canonical_name: Well-Founded Recursion, Termination Measures & Functional Induction
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Set-theoretic well-founded recursion: frfi, wfrlem $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Set-theoretic transfinite/well-founded recursion theorem (`frfi`) constructing a function class as a union of approximations.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Replace `frfi` approximation unions with native `termination_by` recursive definitions in Lean 4.
dialect_pitfalls: `frfi` restricts the recursive call via function restriction `( F |` Pred(R, A, x) )`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: def f (x : alpha) : beta := ... termination_by measure x decreasing_by omega | fun_induction f x with ...

mechanisms.canonical_name: Measure Spaces, Lebesgue/Bochner Integration & Almost-Everywhere Filters
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: ( S _|_ F ) , F e. Mbf , F e. Itg
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Lebesgue measure (`vol`) and integral (`itg1`, `itg2`, `Mbf`, `Itg`) on `R` plus general outer measure spaces (`oms`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `F e. Mbf` -> `Measurable f` (`by measurability`), `F e. Itg` -> `Integrable f volume`, and `(S _|_ F)` -> `∫ x in S, f x`.
dialect_pitfalls: Default `set.mm` `itg` is 1D Lebesgue integration over `R`; multidimensional integrals use product measures
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∫ x in s, f x ∂μ | ∫⁻ x, g x ∂μ | ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, P x | filter_upwards [h1, h2] with x hx1 hx2

mechanisms.canonical_name: Big Operators, Finite Sums/Products & Indexed Monoid Folding
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: sum_ k e. ( M ... N ) A(k) , sum_ x e. S F(x)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Indexed sum `sum_ k e. A B` (`df-fsum`) over integer intervals `(M ... N)` (`df-fz`) or finite sets.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `sum_ k e. (M ... N) A(k)` to `∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc M N, A k` and `fsumshft` to `Finset.sum_Ico_add`.
dialect_pitfalls: In `set.mm`, `(M ... N)` is Over `Z` (integers), so `M` and `N` can be negative
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ∑ x ∈ s, f x | ∏ x ∈ s, f x | ∑ x ∈ s with P x, f x

mechanisms.canonical_name: Bitvectors, Machine Words, SWAR & Bit-Blasting Decision Procedures
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Set of binary bit positions: ( bits ` N ) $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Set-theoretic representation `(bits ` N) = { k e. N0 | floor(N / 2^k) mod 2 = 1 }`.
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `k e. (bits ` N)` to `Nat.testBit n k = true` or `BitVec.getLsbD x k`.
dialect_pitfalls: Metamath `bits` models arbitrary-precision natural numbers rather than fixed-width two's complement words
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: by bv_decide | by bv_omega | ext i hi; simp [BitVec.getLsbD]

mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: $( Class & function extensionality: eqrdv, fneqi, abbi $)
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: ZFC Axiom of Extensionality (`ax-ext`, `eqrdv`) and function graph extensionality (`fneqi`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `eqrdv` and `fneqi` to `ext x` and `fveq2i`/`oveq12i` to `congrArg` / `congr`.
dialect_pitfalls: Metamath functions are sets of ordered pairs, so `F = G` is literally set extensionality on pairs `<x, y>`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: ext x y | funext x | congr 1

mechanisms.canonical_name: Filters, Nets, Eventualities & Topological Limit Convergence
mechanisms.dialect_syntax_pattern: F : A -cn-> B , ( F ~> L ) , F e. ( J -cn-> K )
mechanisms.dialect_semantics: Topological continuity (`cn`), sequence convergence (`clim`: `F ~> L`), and general filter convergence (`flim`).
mechanisms.dialect_idiom: Translate `(F ~> L)` to `Tendsto F atTop (𝓝 L)` and `F : A -cn-> B` to `ContinuousOn f A` (`by fun_prop`).
dialect_pitfalls: `set.mm` `(F ~> L)` is a relational symbol (since limits need not be unique in non-Hausdorff spaces) and becomes a function value only under `T2`
mechanisms.lean4_target_syntax: Tendsto f (𝓝 x) (𝓝 y) | Tendsto u atTop (𝓝 l) | ∀ᶠ n in atTop, P n
